description: No clean concept found. Fires mostly in the opening (about 4-14 stones) when I have no stone in column 6 and the opponent sits low in the centre-right, typically on top of my stone at (row 1, col 3) or (row 1, col 5); strongest when the opponent has a diagonal (3,3),(2,4),(1,5) aimed at the bottom-right corner. Single-stone edits switch it on/off unpredictably; it rarely fires in mid/late game.
effect: None measurable: forcing it high or off moves column probabilities by at most ~0.10, in inconsistent directions (e.g. +col6/-col5 in one opening, +col4 in another).
notes: 5 dev scores, all F1 0.12-0.15 (best p3 F1 0.152, P 0.11, R 0.24, AUROC 0.59, sim share 0.03; additive cell heuristic F1 0.150 sim 0.06). Tried: early game/col6 empty; hand-weighted enriched cells; opponent at (1,3)/(1,5); opponent adjacent pair; opponent capping my stone. Minimal pairs are idiosyncratic (1,3,3,3 fires 1.75, 0,3,3,3 and 2,3,3,3 do not). Likely random direction or mixture. Synthesis beats dev max (8.41 vs 7.68).
